definitions.explanation: Fish that is freshly caught and has not been frozen, dried, or otherwise processed. Often used in commercial and market contexts.

examples.japanese: {鮮魚|せんぎょ}コーナーで{魚|さかな}を{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: To choose fish at the fresh fish counter.

examples.japanese: この{市場|いちば}は{鮮魚|せんぎょ}の{品揃|しなぞろ}えがいい。
examples.english: This market has a great selection of fresh fish.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{港|みなと}から{届|とど}く{鮮魚|せんぎょ}を{使|つか}って、{刺身|さしみ}や{寿司|すし}を{提供|ていきょう}しています。
examples.english: We serve sashimi and sushi made with fresh fish delivered from the harbor every morning.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen as signage in supermarkets and fish markets. The {鮮魚|せんぎょ} section is a standard department in Japanese supermarkets. More formal and commercial than simply saying {新鮮|しんせん}な{魚|さかな} (fresh fish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ}コーナー (fresh fish counter/section)
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ}{売|う}り{場|ば} (fresh fish department)
- {鮮魚|せんぎょ}{店|てん} (fish shop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刺身|さしみ}: sashimi — sliced raw fish, a preparation rather than a category
- {干物|ひもの}: dried fish — fish that has been preserved by drying
